PARISH ENVELOPE & STANDING ORDER / DONATIONS 1ST COLLECTION COMMON FUND & DUES ENVELOPES 2ND COLLECTION SHARE The Envelope/Standing Orders are what funds the Parish.
This money stays locally and is vital to sustain our Parish.
The money from these envelopes and Standing Orders maintain the Churches, Parish Centre, Houses, general maintenance and administration expenses.

The Common Fund account is funded by all the loose notes & coins in the First Collection It is used to provide suitable and equitable remuneration and support for all priests serving in the diocese, including active, sick, and retired clergy . The Share account is funded by all loose notes & coins in the Second collection.
It is primarily used to finance central support services for all parishes, and to provide financial assistance to low-income parishes.
